$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=7\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\text{d}x=\frac{1}{7}\,\text{d}u.
$$

We can now rewrite the integral in terms of $u,$ solve it, and write the final answer in terms of $x$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{8}{7x+5}\,\text{d}x & =8\int \frac{1}{u}\cdot\left(\frac{1}{7}\,\text{d}u\right) \\ & =\frac{8}{7}\int \frac{1}{u}\,\text{d}u \\ & =\frac{8}{7}\operatorname{ln}⁡|u|+C \\ & =\frac{8}{7}\operatorname{ln}⁡|7x+5|+C\end{aligned}
$$
